name: Canaria-Systems-S5-row-streamed-attention-v1
source: S4 raw learned G7 compiler tensors and fixed S4 activation/reference
algorithm: For each block retain x and pre-attention LayerNorm z, compute full K and V only, compute Q one query row at a time, attend only to causal prefix, softmax scores in-place, update x row in-place, then release z/K/V before MLP. Never allocate BxHxTxT scores.

memory_accounting.scope: explicit managed float32 tensor payload; excludes Python/NumPy/SciPy code, ndarray metadata, OS page cache, .npy headers, and opaque library temporaries

interpretation_boundary: Logical tensor-memory prototype only. Passing does not mean the Python process fits in 64 KiB or that a 64-KiB MCU can execute it.
